title: Autoloads fail to load in exported Windows build
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.7.stable.mono.official [5b4e0cb0f]
- Not reproducible in v4.6.3.stable.mono.official [7d41c59c4]

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6607) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900HX with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 31.42 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When launching the exported build there are errors in the console about failing to load an autoload and unrecognized uids:

```
ERROR: Unrecognized UID: "uid://dmfv48yn6x062".
ERROR: No loader found for resource: res:// (expected type: unknown)
   at: (core/io/resource_loader.cpp:332)
ERROR: Failed to instantiate an autoload, can't load from path: .
   at: (main/main.cpp:4529)
```

Additionally when clicking export with a .cs script as an autoload there is an error in the editor output:
```
ERROR: /root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/NativeInterop/ExceptionUtils.cs:113 - System.ArgumentException: Resource of type CSharpScript has an invalid file extension: uid://dmfv48yn6x062 (Parameter 'path')
```

This error is present in 4.6.3 editor, but autoloads work correctly in the build.

Replacing UIDs in project.godot with actual file paths fixes the issue, but it is not very manageable to keep track of.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the attached project
2. Click Project->Export->Export project...
You will see "Resource of type CSharpScript has an invalid file extension" error when build is finished.
3. Launch the console version of the build
You will see the UID errors in the console

If you remove NETAutoload the error that happens after build is finished will disappear, but the build will fail to load gdscript autoload.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test-export.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31552347/test-export.zip)
